# Accessible Support Contact Form

A modern, accessible contact form component built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript that meets WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards.

## Files

- **index.html** - Main HTML file with form structure and semantic markup
- **styles.css** - Modern, responsive styling with accessibility features
- **script.js** - Client-side validation and form handling

## Features

### Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)
- ✓ Skip to main content link
- ✓ Semantic HTML with proper landmarks
- ✓ Visible focus indicators
- ✓ ARIA labels and descriptions
- ✓ Keyboard operable
- ✓ Proper color contrast
- ✓ Screen reader friendly
- ✓ Responsive to reduced-motion preferences
- ✓ High contrast mode support

### Form Fields
- **Full Name** (Required) - Text input with validation
- **Email Address** (Required) - Email input with format validation
- **Phone Number** (Optional) - Tel input with format helper text
- All fields wrapped in `form-field` divs as specified

### Validation
- Real-time inline error messages
- Validation on blur and on form submission
- Proper aria-invalid and aria-describedby attributes
- Errors start with "Error:" prefix
- Phone field accepts multiple formats: (123) 456-7890, +1 (123) 456-7890, 123-456-7890
- Required fields marked visually (*) and programmatically

### Design
- Clean, modern product design
- Gradient background
- Card-based form container
- Smooth transitions and interactions
- Mobile responsive (works at 320px width)

## Keyboard Navigation
- Tab/Shift+Tab through form fields
- Visible focus indicator on all interactive elements
- Enter to submit form
- Focus management on form submission (moves to first error or shows success)

## Browser Support
Works in all modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) with JavaScript enabled. Degrades gracefully with basic HTML5 validation as fallback.
EOF
